name: Question 1
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14003808/assets/8b1d78038032973d7bb5738b67963e0bfadb258e4c1eb06f191496bded406696.png)

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
The vertex of a right-opening parabola is the left-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14003808/assets/aaf295d69a75c976df8aaf02ee6680486c502f7ce5719b41682cdf2499cab984.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(-6,0).$

Question 1
?

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?

a
(0,−6)
b
(−6,0)
c
(−4,0)
d
(0,−4)
e
(6,0)
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The vertex of a right-opening parabola is the left-most point of the parabola.

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are (−6,0).
